caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, slightly curved object resembling a fabric pouch or small bag, positioned upright in the center of a plain background. The pouch has a drawstring at the top, illustrated with light green and yellow hues, appearing as two loosely tied ribbons with visible folds and shading. The main surface of the pouch is a pale, off-white or cream color and is divided visually into two decorative sections. The left section features a repeating green leafy vine pattern that is dispersed over the background. The right section contains two stylized floral motifs, one above the other, each composed of red and dark green petals, yellow central elements, and small black details. Surrounding these motifs are numerous small, curved, black lines suggesting foliage or decorative filler. The drawing style uses delicate lines and soft washes of color, with no visible background details except for the central object.
title: Cotton Bag
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
